name: dsh-chat-gateway
description: Multi-channel message gateway for the dsh web GUI: connects 钉钉(Stream) / 飞书(长连接) / 企业微信(自建应用回调) / QQ(OneBot 反向WS) bots to a dsh agent with per-conversation sessions (群聊/单聊历史隔离) — every channel gets its own card in an independent 「消息通道」 settings section. Installed via `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-gateway`.
